summary: Sporadic NaNs in generation outputs; suspected correlation with kernel selector v2 choice (long-context / specific shapes)
description:
Customer reports sporadic NaNs during text generation on Dedicated cluster after upgrading runtime to 1.19 (kernel selector v2 enabled for canary cohort). Symptom is either:
- 500 response with error string containing "NaN"/"invalid value" during attention/softmax, OR
- generation returns empty/garbled tokens and trace shows downstream "nan in logits" guard triggering.

Impact:
- Customer running production-like evaluation; intermittent failures break batch jobs and require retries.
- Frequency reported by customer: ~0.3% to 1% of requests, clustered around long-context prompts.

Initial hypothesis:
- Wrong kernel selected for a subset of shapes/seq buckets on specific GPU SKUs, leading to numerical instability (fp16/bf16 accumulation) rather than deterministic shape mismatch.
- Correlation suspected with selector v2 because failures began immediately after runtime-1.19 upgrade and disappear when forcing v1.

Environment (customer provided):
- Dedicated cluster: us-east
- GPU: A10 (primary), some L4 (secondary pool)
- Runtime: 1.19.0 (first build with selector v2 enabled by default for their cohort)
- Model: Qwen-family (customer pinned), occasionally testing a Mistral-family baseline
- Prompt characteristics: long context (8k–16k tokens) with multi-turn chat history; failures often happen at prefill->decode transition (first decode token).

Reproduction hints (customer):
1) Send 16k-ish prompt (multi-message chat), max_output_tokens 256
2) temperature 0.7–1.0, top_p 0.9
3) concurrency >= 8 (batching active)
4) Failures more common when prompt length is near a bucket boundary (customer observed 8192-ish / 12288-ish regions)

What we need from customer (requested):
- 2 failing request IDs (trace_id) and timestamps
- The exact model ID string and whether any quantization profile is enabled
- Whether failures occur on L4 pool as well or only A10

Mitigation:
- Force kernel selector version back to v1 for AcmeAI dedicated cluster (config override) while runtime investigates.
- Additionally pin safe kernel set for affected model family + long-context bucket if needed.

Notes:
- This ticket is tracked as correctness (P0) even though intermittent because NaNs are silent-corruption-adjacent; prioritize safe rollback + conformance coverage.
